metadata.name: E. fimbriata oocyte and spawning data from Foundiougne, Djifer, and Joal
metadata.description: Dataset containing measurements of E. fimbriata oocyte dry mass, volume, lipids, protein, calorific content, and elemental ratios (Ba/Ca, Sr/Ca, Zn/Ca) alongside environmental parameters (temperature, salinity) and spawning batch data. Samples were collected from three locations in Senegal (Foundiougne, Djifer, Joal) between February and October 2014.

metadata.name: MITAPI 2015-2010 Difference by Sector
metadata.description: Dataset containing NetCDF files representing the difference in MIT API (likely a model or index) between the years 2015 and 2010, categorized by various economic sectors including Agriculture (AGR), Energy (ENE), Industry (IND), Power Plant (PPA), Process (PRO), Residential/Commercial (RCO), Reference (REF), Shipping (SHIP), Shortwave (SWD), Transport (TNG), Traffic (TRF), and Tourism (TRO).

metadata.name: Elwha River Delta Elevation Survey
metadata.description: Dataset containing high-resolution topographic survey data of the Elwha River Delta, including latitude, longitude, elevation, and timestamps collected on March 20, 2011. The data includes quality metrics (HRMS, VRMS) and status indicators for various survey profiles and events.

metadata.name: Elwha River Delta Elevation Survey 2012-02-03
metadata.description: Dataset containing high-resolution topographic survey data collected at the Elwha River Delta on February 3, 2012. The data includes latitude, longitude, elevation, timestamps, and quality metrics (HRMS, VRMS) for fixed GPS points, primarily associated with profile PROF132.

metadata.name: Permafrost Parameters in Antarctica (2000-2017)
metadata.description: Dataset containing Mean Annual Ground Temperature (MAGTM), MAGT Standard Deviation (MAGTSTD), and Permafrost Probability Fraction (PERPROB) for Antarctica covering the period from 2000 to 2017.

metadata.name: Pacas hunting record and pregnancy diagnoses in the context of the El Bizri et al. 2019 study
metadata.description: A dataset containing three Excel files: interviews regarding pregnancy diagnoses, hunting registers for pacas including pregnancy and immatures, and catch-per-unit-effort records.

metadata.name: Magallana hongkongensis (mollusk) laboratory experiment data
metadata.description: Laboratory dataset containing physicochemical parameters and mechanical properties (stiffness, hardness, density) of Magallana hongkongensis (mollusk) under various treatments. Includes water chemistry data such as pH, temperature, salinity, alkalinity, pCO2, carbonate ion concentration, and saturation states (Omega Cal, Omega Arg).

metadata.name: Katharinentalerhof Pforzheim Plant Performance and Weather Data
metadata.description: Dataset containing plant performance data, weather data, and Noah-MP model outputs (ECC and LCC scenarios) collected at the Katharinentalerhof site in Pforzheim.

metadata.name: Physiological and biochemical data of fish from Macapule Lagoon
metadata.description: Dataset containing physiological measurements (mass, organ weights, hepatosomatic index, gonadosomatic index, total protein, triglycerides, cholesterol, glucose) and individual codes for fish sampled at Macapule Lagoon across different seasons and size intervals between 2013 and 2015.

metadata.name: Macapule Lagoon Water Quality Data
metadata.description: Dataset containing water quality measurements including temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, pH, ammonia, nitrate, and phosphate collected at Macapule Lagoon across multiple zones and dates.

metadata.name: Mytilus galloprovincialis embryonic development under high CO2 conditions
metadata.description: Laboratory dataset containing developmental stage percentages and physiological parameters (pH, temperature, salinity, carbonate chemistry) for the mussel Mytilus galloprovincialis exposed to Control and High CO2 treatments over time (2 to 144 hours). Data includes observations of embryonic stages (1-cell to D-larva) and abnormality types.

metadata.name: PS87-track Whale Observations
metadata.description: Dataset containing whale and dolphin observations recorded during the PS87 track, including date/time, geographic coordinates, species identification, certainty level, individual count, and event identifier.

metadata.name: Balloon_20180818_1109_1139
metadata.description: Meteorological balloon sounding data collected on August 18, 2018, containing time-series measurements of atmospheric parameters including pressure, temperature, relative humidity, wind direction, and wind speed, along with GPS coordinates and altitude.

metadata.name: C0023A Core Samples Alk and Diols Peak Area Data
metadata.description: Dataset containing chemical analysis results (Alk peak area, Diols peak area) for sediment core samples from site C0023A, including sample depths, coordinates, elevation, and collection date.

metadata.name: UPC Sensor Data 2020
metadata.description: Dataset containing metadata for sensor output and input files associated with the UPC event, including file names, types, sizes, location coordinates, elevation, and timestamps.

metadata.name: Birkeland Cruise Siphonophore Video Data
metadata.description: Dataset containing video recordings of fish and siphonophores collected during the Birkeland Cruise, including event identifiers, file metadata, and geospatial-temporal coordinates.

metadata.name: PS106 Aerosol Chemical Composition
metadata.description: Dataset containing chemical composition measurements of aerosols collected during the PS106 expedition. Data includes concentrations of various ions (Cl-, NO3-, SO4 2-, etc.) across different aerosol size ranges (0.05-10 micrometers) at multiple sampling stages, with associated geographic coordinates, timestamps, and sampling heights.

metadata.name: NunaWP4 Mackenzie 2019 Stable Isotope Data
metadata.description: Dataset containing water stable isotope measurements (delta18O, deltaD, and d xs) collected at various stations in the Mackenzie River region during the NunaWP4 expedition in 2019. The data includes geographic coordinates, water depth, and sampling timestamps for multiple stations across four expedition legs.

metadata.name: NunaWP4Mackenzie19 IFDOM and FDOM measurements
metadata.description: Dataset containing In-situ Fluorescence Dissolved Organic Matter (IFDOM) and Fluorescence Dissolved Organic Matter (FDOM) peak and ratio measurements collected at various stations in the Mackenzie River region during the NunaWP4Mackenzie19 expedition in 2019. The data includes geographic coordinates, water depth, and specific fluorescence parameters (C1, C2, C3, A-peak, C-peak, M-peak, T-peak) and indices (FI, HI, BI).

metadata.name: WDC06A Ice Core Gas Age and Isotope Data
metadata.description: Dataset containing measurements from the WDC06A ice core, including depth, gas age, oxygen isotope ratios (δ18O, δ18O_2), and clumped isotope values (Δ36, Δ36_2). All samples were collected at a single location on December 9, 2006.

metadata.name: SO268_043MUC German collector trial pre-impact sediment core geochemistry
metadata.description: Geochemical data from a sediment core (SO268_043MUC) collected during the German collector trial pre-impact. The dataset includes elemental concentrations (Al, Ba, Ca, Cr, Cu, Fe, K, La, Li, Mg, Mn, Na, Ni, P, Sr, Ti) and their relative values at various sediment depths, along with station metadata, geographic coordinates, elevation, and collection timestamp.

metadata.name: SO268_074MUC Belgian collector trial pre-impact sediment core geochemistry
metadata.description: Geochemical data from sediment core SO268_074MUC collected during the Belgian collector trial pre-impact. The dataset includes concentrations and relative abundances of various elements (Al, Ba, Ca, Cr, Cu, Fe, K, La, Li, Mg, Mn, Na, Ni, P, Sr, Ti) at different sediment depths, along with station metadata, coordinates, elevation, and sampling timestamps.

metadata.name: Sylt trawl survey data
metadata.description: Dataset containing trawl survey observations from the Sylt region, including geographic coordinates, bathymetry, sampling dates, habitat type, Scomber scombrus (Atlantic mackerel) total length and counts, salinity, and temperature.

metadata.name: PS122/5_61-35 ROV Quicklook Data
metadata.description: Dataset containing quicklook images and metadata from an ROV survey (Event PS122/5_61-35) conducted on September 8, 2020. The data includes visualizations and time series for ADCP current backscatter, DVL, depth profiles (ECO, GPCTD, Transmittance, VIPER Spectra), optics (PAR, Transmittance), positioning, sea ice draft distribution, telemetry, and pH overview.

metadata.name: TopographicHigh_RawData
metadata.description: Dataset containing raw data files for various geographic locations including Big Skidder, Black Hills, Blue Hills, Cougar Mountain, Devils Mountain, Dow Mountain, Fidalgo Island, Lopez Island, and San Juan, provided in GIS, XLSX, and ZIP formats.

metadata.name: Mn nodule geochemical data from CHALICE and OKSH expeditions
metadata.description: Dataset containing geochemical measurements (Mn, Fe, Ni, Co, Cu) and physical descriptions of manganese nodules collected from various locations in the Pacific Ocean. The data includes sample IDs, coordinates, elevation, sediment depth, and collection dates from 1970.

metadata.name: B. saida biological and environmental data from expeditions PS80, PS92, PS106, and PS122
metadata.description: Dataset containing biological measurements (Total Length, Standard Length, wet mass, sex, Condition Index, Degree of digestion, stomach content mass and content) and environmental data (location, depth, date, gear type) for the species B. saida collected during expeditions PS80, PS92, PS106, and PS122. Samples were preserved and analyzed for stomach content and other biological parameters.

metadata.name: Lake Constance TP Concentration Time Series
metadata.description: Dataset containing Total Phosphorus (TP) concentration measurements from Lake Constance at the Fischbach-Uttwil station. Data includes concentrations averaged for July, August, and September for the upper 20 meters of the water column from 1967 to 2010, and concentrations during the winter mixing period for the whole water column (0-250 m) from 1951 to 2010.

metadata.name: PLDS04MV-109BX Mn Nodule Geochemical Data
metadata.description: Geochemical composition data for Manganese (Mn) nodules collected at a single location in the Pacific Ocean. The dataset includes elemental concentrations (Al, Si, Ca, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ba, Sc, Sb, La, Ce, Nd, Sm, Eu, Tb, Ho, Yb, Lu, Hf, Th, U) for different sample types (topside, underside, bulk) taken from a nodule at a depth of 4722 meters.

metadata.name: M186_50-1GC Pore Water Geochemistry
metadata.description: Geochemical analysis of pore water samples from sediment core M186_50-1GC, including concentrations of nutrients (nitrate, nitrite, ammonium, phosphate), major ions (chloride, sulfate, bromide, boron, manganese, calcium, iron, sodium, magnesium, strontium, silicon, barium, lithium, potassium), temperature, and depth. Data collected at a single station on 2022-12-15.

metadata.name: Geochemical composition of sediment pore water from core M186_54-1GC
metadata.description: Dataset containing geochemical measurements of sediment pore water from core M186_54-1GC, including concentrations of nutrients (nitrate, nitrite, ammonium, phosphate), major ions (chloride, sulfate, bromide), and trace elements (boron, manganese, calcium, iron, sodium, magnesium, strontium, silicon, barium, lithium, potassium) at various sediment depths.

metadata.name: Limacina helicina laboratory incubation experiments 2019
metadata.description: Laboratory experimental data for the pteropod Limacina helicina collected in September 2019. The dataset includes physiological and biogeochemical measurements such as temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, pH, pCO2, and carbonate system parameters (DIC, AT, Omega Arg, Omega Cal) under control and incubation conditions at two depths (500m and 2993m).

metadata.name: Baltic Sea pCO2 climatology and trend
metadata.description: Dataset containing Baltic Sea pCO2 climatology and long-term trend data.

metadata.name: Salp and Pyrosome Elemental Composition and Morphometrics from IOS20210060, MIE_1, ANT-XXI/4, ANT-XXIII/2, ANT-XXIII/6, and TAN0806
metadata.description: Dataset containing elemental composition (C, N, H, ash, dry mass) and morphometric measurements (size, mass) of salp and pyrosome species (Salpa aspera, Salpa thompsoni, Ihlea racovitzai, Pyrosoma atlanticum, Salpa fusiformis, Soestia zonaria, Thetys vagina) collected during expeditions IOS20210060, MIE_1, ANT-XXI/4, ANT-XXIII/2, ANT-XXIII/6, and TAN0806. Data includes sample IDs, collection dates, vessel names, station locations, gear types, water depths, and tissue descriptors.

metadata.name: WA_CapeBlossom_20210625_7cm_01
metadata.description: Dataset containing aerial imagery and derived products including RGB and CIR previews, DSM, Ortho, hillshade, point clouds, and tile footprints for the WA_CapeBlossom site collected on 2021-06-25.

metadata.name: NM01_04_S01 Ice and Snow Density and Depth Measurements
metadata.description: Dataset containing measurements of ice/snow depth, ice density, and descriptive depth for samples collected at a single location on 2004-12-29. The data includes sample identifiers, depth intervals, and associated image filenames.

metadata.name: Physico-chemical, Particulate matter, Temperature, and Hydrological Data
metadata.description: Dataset containing physico-chemical data (in situ parameters, nutrients, trace elements, contaminants), particulate matter data (cations, trace elements, mineralogy), continuous temperature data at sampling sites, and hydrological data (modeled and measured mean daily discharge).

metadata.name: Porites sp. Geochemical Data from TIAREI-A1
metadata.description: Dataset containing geochemical measurements (Sr/Ca, Mg/Ca, δ18O, δ13C) from Porites sp. coral cores, including age models, event markers, and location data (Latitude, Longitude, Elevation) for the TIAREI-A1 site.

metadata.name: Flade Isblink Ice Cap Cryoconite and Sediment Samples
metadata.description: Dataset containing geochemical and radionuclide measurements (including 137Cs, 210Pb, 241Am, 7Be, 40K, Pu isotopes) from cryoconite, river sediment (glacial), and river sediment (non-glacial) samples collected on the Flade Isblink Ice Cap. The data includes sample coordinates, depth, type, moisture status, grain size, loss on ignition, and various isotopic concentrations and ratios.

metadata.name: Santiurde_section Geochemical and Lithological Data
metadata.description: Dataset containing geochemical and lithological measurements (Qz, Clay, Cal, Gp, Dol, Py) and physical properties (Thick, Ratio, Strat height) for samples collected at the Santiurde section, including sample identifiers, coordinates, and elevation.

metadata.name: DML21/22 Snow Density and Depth Profiles
metadata.description: Dataset containing snow depth, snow density, and depth intervals (top and bottom) measured at various locations in Antarctica during the DML21/22 campaign. Data includes measurements from multiple events (e.g., DML21/22_Refl01LG, DML21/22_QR3, DML21/22_R02LG) recorded between December 2021 and January 2022.

metadata.name: Puchalski_AWS Daily Meteorological Data
metadata.description: Daily meteorological observations from the Puchalski Automatic Weather Station (AWS), including temperature, humidity, wind, and solar radiation data.

metadata.name: Kiwada_Kazusa_Chiba_Ono_River_and_Yuki_River_section
metadata.description: Dataset containing sediment core samples from the Ono River and Yuki River sections in the Kiwada Kazusa Chiba area, including sample IDs, section depths, ages, sedimentation rates, references, and geographic coordinates.

metadata.name: Uelzen, Germany: 6 band color composits, Vegetation index, Metabolism index, and Shape files
metadata.description: Dataset containing 6 band color composits, vegetation indices (NDVI), and metabolism indices (NirV) for Uelzen, Germany, spanning from 1984 to 2023. The data is provided as GeoTIFF files covering specific time periods (May-July and August-October) for various years. Additionally, the dataset includes shape files (dbf, prj, shp, shx) representing zones for the same years.

metadata.name: Aalen, Germany - Remote Sensing Time Series (1984-2023)
metadata.description: Dataset containing remote sensing data for Aalen, Germany, including 6-band color composites, vegetation indices (NDVI), and metabolism indices (NirV) derived from satellite imagery. The data covers the period from 1984 to 2023 with observations typically in May-July and August-October. The dataset also includes associated shapefiles for various years.

metadata.name: NEP Soil Geochemistry and Dating Data
metadata.description: Dataset containing soil geochemical measurements (U, Th, K, De) and dating results (Age dated) from samples collected at two locations (NEP_1 and NEP_3) in 2023. Includes sample labels, lab labels, soil depth, elevation, and collection timestamps.

metadata.name: Radiocarbon and U-series dating from archaeological sites in Borneo
metadata.description: A compilation of radiocarbon and U-series dating results from various archaeological sites across Borneo, including Malaysia (Sabah, Sarawak) and Indonesia (Kalimantan). The dataset contains sample identifiers, site names, dating methods (Radiocarbon age, U-series, U-Th), uncalibrated and calibrated ages with standard deviations, and associated references.

metadata.name: PS101/186-R1 and PS101/186-R2 Geochemical Data
metadata.description: Dataset containing geochemical composition (SiO2, TiO2, Al2O3, Fe2O3, MnO, MgO, CaO, Na2O, K2O, P2O5) and total values for samples PS101/186-R1 and PS101/186-R2, collected at event PS101/186-1 with associated location (Latitude, Longitude, Elevation) and timestamp.

metadata.name: Geochemical and Isotopic Data from ODP Site 680A
metadata.description: Dataset containing geochemical and isotopic measurements from sediment core 112-680A, including elemental concentrations (Al, Ca, Fe, K, Mn, Na, P, Mo, U, N, S), TOC, TC, Fe fractions, isotope ratios (δ15N, δ13C, δ98Mo), and sample metadata such as depth, epoch, and location.

metadata.name: MSM44_362-1 Sediment Core Physical Properties
metadata.description: Dataset containing physical property measurements from sediment core MSM44_362-1, including depth, section, core diameter deviation, P-wave travel time, P-wave velocity (Vp-a), and acoustic grain size (AGR). Data was collected at a single location on July 12, 2015.

metadata.name: Sucha Woda Flood Boulder and Trunk Measurements
metadata.description: Dataset containing measurements of boulder diameters and trunk counts at 11 sites following the Sucha Woda flood event on July 24, 2018. Includes site location coordinates, elevation, and detailed boulder diameter data across 25 columns per site.

metadata.name: ANT 1997/98 EMR Radar Profiles
metadata.description: Dataset containing metadata for EMR radar profiles collected during the ANT 1997/98 season. The data includes profile IDs, instrument settings (600 ns and 60 ns pulses), and links to associated netCDF data files, KML files, and images.

metadata.name: X. umbellata pulsation under different treatments
metadata.description: Laboratory experiment data measuring X. umbellata pulsation rates across 12 tanks (T1-T12) under different treatments (Zooplankton, Control, DOC, Phytoplankton) at time intervals of 0, 7, 14, 21, and 28 days.

metadata.name: Uvigerina spp. stable isotope data from sediment core M78/1_181-3
metadata.description: Dataset containing depth, age, and stable isotope measurements (δ13C and δ18O) of Uvigerina spp. from sediment core M78/1_181-3. The data includes geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude, elevation) and sampling date.

metadata.name: 386-M0095B Sediment Mineralogy and Geochemistry
metadata.description: Dataset containing mineralogical composition (XRD) and geochemical data for sediment samples from IODP Site 386-M0095B, including depth, sample labels, and coordinates.

metadata.name: BH-II and BH-rec sediment core geochemical and grain size data
metadata.description: Dataset containing geochemical parameters (TOC, BC, CaCO3, pH, TP, Pb, Zn, Cu, S, isotopes), grain size distribution, magnetic susceptibility, and physical properties from sediment cores BH-II and BH-rec. Includes depth, elevation, and sampling coordinates.

metadata.name: IODP Site 383-U1539 Sediment Core Paleotemperature Data
metadata.description: Paleotemperature (SST) and standard deviation measurements from sediment core samples collected at IODP Site 383 (cores U1539A, U1539C, U1539D). The dataset includes sample labels, sediment depth, age, cluster information, and sampling dates.

metadata.name: Sediment core geochemical and physical properties from Arctic sites
metadata.description: Dataset containing geochemical and physical properties of sediment cores collected from various Arctic locations. Includes measurements of Total Organic Carbon (TOC), Total Inorganic Carbon (TIC), Total Nitrogen (TN), stable isotopes (delta13C, delta15N), grain size distribution, sedimentation rates, accumulation rates, and age models derived from depth intervals.

metadata.description: Dataset containing sediment core measurements including depth, Total Organic Carbon (TOC), and Total Inorganic Carbon (TIC) from core GeoB16310-3 collected at a single location in the Gulf of Mexico on 2012-03-23.

metadata.name: GeoB16320-2 Sediment TOC and TIC Data
metadata.description: Dataset containing sediment core measurements including depth, Total Organic Carbon (TOC), and Total Inorganic Carbon (TIC) from a single location collected on 2012-03-24.
